description: NovaWing v0.1 (Guardian-centric legacy) vs v0.2 (TaskStateV2 + TaskController) benchmark task set. Frozen before any comparison run. Sources are real NovaWing git-history refs where stated.

tasks.source: git history: feat/work-session MVP docs & localize UI commits (f578f5e, 4e82f11)
tasks.goal: Add a short architecture note to the README describing the approved-mainline snapshot boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: README documents the approved-mainline snapshot boundary

tasks.source: git history: many small type-fix fixes across work-session (6b6c392 fix control-plane optional clock type)
tasks.goal: Fix a local TypeScript type error without changing behavior.

tasks.source: git history: W004-B 补全验收测试 pattern (6769d10, 4ca9398)
tasks.goal: Add a focused unit test covering a documented invariant.

tasks.source: git history: fix(brain): recover from stale reviewer conversations (4032f05)
tasks.goal: Fix a locally reproducible bug in a focused module and add regression coverage.

tasks.source: git history: feat(executor): add Codex local runtime with DeepSeek failover (4409273)
tasks.goal: Implement a small multi-file feature touching a module, its types and a test.

tasks.source: git history: fix(work-session): recover retained executor ownership (ed7a5d8) — verification fail then repair
tasks.goal: First attempt breaks a check; the task must repair until deterministic verification passes.

tasks.source: git history: refactor: execution-ledger observability hardening (d69ea87, 6b4885f)
tasks.goal: Refactor a local helper to a cleaner shape preserving all behavior and evidence.

tasks.source: git history: V2 enforces observed file permissions (v2-controller test), W003 permission enforcement
tasks.goal: Attempt an edit that violates a forbidden path; the task must not proceed to completion.

work.blockReason: changed file is outside allowed scope: .env

tasks.source: git history: HIGH review identity hardening (5fd9c6a), risk-evidence HIGH review gate
tasks.goal: Deliver a security-sensitive change that requires an independent HIGH-risk review before completion.
tasks.notRunReason: HIGH review semantics are v0.2-only (risk engine + independent reviewer identity); v0.1 has no comparable independent-review gate. Not comparable via shared executor.

tasks.source: git history: CRITICAL approval scope (4e2ebdd), risk-evidence CRITICAL approval gate
tasks.goal: Deliver a change touching auth and database schema that requires explicit CRITICAL human approval.
tasks.notRunReason: CRITICAL risk/approval is a v0.2-only concept; v0.1 has no comparable approval scope. Not comparable via shared executor.

tasks.source: git history: Codex quota exhaustion -> DeepSeek failover (4409273, 114afc1 controlled injection)
tasks.goal: Execute a coding task while the active provider exhausts quota mid-run; work must continue on the fallback provider.
tasks.notRunReason: Real quota exhaustion requires live provider execution; both engines share ExecutorRouter, so provider-switch is transport, not v0.1-vs-v0.2 deltas. Requires live provider (UNAVAILABLE).

tasks.source: git history: repository reality reconciliation (v2-repository-reality test), W003 repo drift
tasks.goal: Persisted task facts must reconcile against a changed repository before any dispatch.
tasks.notRunReason: Repository-drift handling is a runtime/reconcile concern shared by both engines at the WorkSession layer; requires real repo + restart. Not a per-task executor delta.

tasks.source: git history: restart persistence & recovery (4e2ebdd, 5fd9c6a, v2-observability-runtime-restart test)
tasks.goal: A task suspended mid-work must recover after a process restart without losing canonical state or evidence.
tasks.notRunReason: Restart recovery is exercised at the WorkSessionRuntime integration layer; both engines' restart guarantees are already covered by dedicated integration tests. Needs real runtime (out of per-task executor scope).

tasks.source: git history: partial progress + resume / suspend resume patterns (W003 exact resume, W005-B resume)
tasks.goal: A task that made partial progress then paused must resume from that progress.
acceptanceCriteria: resume continues without redoing completed work
tasks.notRunReason: Partial-progress resume is a session/runtime concern (suspend/resume), covered by dedicated runtime tests; not a single-pass executor delta.

tasks.source: git history: build/typecheck failure repair (many fix commits touching build gates)
tasks.goal: First build attempt fails; repair until the build gate is green.

tasks.source: git history: provider unavailable / dependency preflight failures (71a768d dependency recovery & preflight)
tasks.goal: Attempt a task while the provider/runtime is unavailable; the task must suspend without corrupting state.
tasks.notRunReason: Provider-offline requires a live/unavailable provider condition; deterministic single-run cannot exercise it comparably.
